**Northbank Community Garden Notice**

The north gate closes Saturday, 18 April, from 9 am to 2 pm. Crews will repair a leaking water pipe during this window. Please use the east entrance for all garden access. This detour is mandatory while repairs are underway. We appreciate your cooperation in keeping the site safe and accessible for everyone involved.

The seed swap has moved. It now takes place on Sunday at 11 am. Adjust your schedules accordingly. Bring any seeds you wish to exchange. There is no change to the format, only the day and time. Ensure you arrive promptly to participate fully in the swap.

Volunteers are needed for general assistance. All necessary tools are supplied on-site. You must bring your own work gloves. Safety is our priority, so proper hand protection is non-negotiable for anyone handling materials or helping with cleanup efforts. Do not arrive without gloves, as you will not be permitted to join the work crew.

Contact Mina to coordinate volunteer efforts. She manages the sign-up sheet and assigns specific tasks based on current needs. Reach out to her directly if you plan to help. This ensures we have adequate coverage for all required jobs. Do not assume a spot is available without confirming with Mina first. Her coordination helps us maintain order and efficiency throughout the weekend activities.

These changes are effective immediately. Check this notice board for future updates regarding gate status or event scheduling. We rely on clear communication to keep the garden running smoothly. Thank you for reading and adapting to these necessary adjustments. Your attention to these details helps us maintain a functional space for all residents.
